head: Samsung: core Galaxy AI features stay free, some new ones may cost extra
dek: Samsung told Tech Advisor its core Galaxy AI features will remain free, after a leak pointed to a $4.99-a-month Galaxy AI Premium plan. It said some advanced capabilities or new services may become paid options.
details: The statement leaves room for a paid tier without confirming one. SammyGuru's leak lists six features that would stay free: Browsing Assist, Now Brief, Creative Studio, Smart Capture, Samsung Keyboard and Personal Agent, though possibly with usage limits.
means: The Galaxy AI features on your phone today shouldn't start costing money; new ones might.
todo: Nothing to do now; if a paid plan comes, check what stays free before you pay.
thumb_words: GALAXY AI: CORE FEATURES STAY FREE
